name: Perpendicular Slice Extraction Geometry
definition: Computes the geometric properties of a slice perpendicular to a given axis (x, y, or z) at a specific RAS index. Returns the slice dimensions, a plane matrix (orientation/position in RAS), and a `sliceAccess` function to map 2D slice coordinates (i,j) to 3D volume data indices.
summary: Perpendicular Slice Extraction Geometry computes slice properties aligned strictly with primary anatomical axes, explicitly handling RAS-to-IJK coordinate transformations unlike general plane slicing.
